hero.indexed: registry row, file on disk, bytes match the manifest
hero.indexed-stale: indexed, but a newer approved lock exists — a release will repoint it
hero.indexed-missing-file: registry row points at a file that is not on disk
hero.indexed-manifest-mismatch: the file on disk does not match the manifest hash
hero.approved-not-indexed: approved and locked by hash; no registry row yet
hero.approved-not-locked: approved on a card; not yet locked
hero.changes_requested: Jordan asked for a change on the latest card
hero.rendered: an image exists on a card; no decision

plate.plated: front + cap-off plate served by Convex, glass the right size, built from the PSD master
plate.plated-no-capoff-by-design: two-piece product (bulb, tassel, atomizer, reducer, dropper): served, no cap to take off
plate.plated-wrong-size: served, but the glass is more than 5% off its bottle's width — the plate is wrong and must be rebuilt
plate.plated-legacy-source: served, but built from a legacy website GIF rather than the PSD master — to be rebuilt
plate.plated-cap-on-only: front plate only; this product should have a cap-off view and does not
plate.hold: held with a reason, no plate
plate.not-applicable: not a bottle (component, packaging, gift bag/box)

kit.live: kit served by Convex and registered to the current plate
kit.stale: kit exists but not registered to the served plate
kit.approved-not-published: approved on a kit card; not published
kit.changes_requested: change requested on the latest kit card
kit.rejected: rejected on the latest kit card
kit.pending: on a kit card, decision pending
kit.not-applicable: no kit for this product kind
kit.rendered: kit image on a card, no decision

scoring.hero: per PRODUCT GROUP — the catalogue shows one hero per group, so a family is scored on groups covered, not SKUs
scoring.plate: per SKU that is a bottle; complete only when the plate is served, the right size for its bottle, from the PSD master, and has its cap-off view unless the product is two-piece
scoring.kit: per SKU that can take a kit (SKUs marked not-applicable are excluded)
scoring.complete: a family is complete when heroes, plates and kits are all complete and nothing is flagged or stale
